resources.string:
• Dating and Friends are separate apps/spaces but share the same account and subscription.
• No boosting, no paywalled core features; premium removes ads only.
• Require meaningful profiles (text is required; photos alone are not enough).
• Clear onboarding message: ghosting is discouraged and may reduce visibility.

• Required on sign-up: phone number, first name, last name, birthday, and email.\n• These fields are locked after signup; changes require support approval.\n• 18+ only with verification flow for flagged ages.

• User-initiated deletion blocks re-registration with the same data for 2 weeks.
• During that window, login shows: “This account has currently scheduled a deletion; the deletion will be done by <date>. Restoring the account will cancel the deletion.”
• Inactivity: delete accounts inactive for 1 month, allow a 2-week restore window, then delete data permanently.
• Scheduled-for-deletion accounts are hidden from discovery, chats marked inactive, and new matches disabled.
• Subscriptions are canceled when an account is deleted.

• Matches only happen when both sides explicitly agree.
• Accepting a request requires writing a message (min 20 chars); this becomes the first chat message.
• A request expires after 2 weeks.
• Warning on acceptance: ghosting is discouraged and may reduce match success.
• Unmatch triggers a 24-hour review window for the other user to flag; chat hides sensitive data in that window.

• Advanced filters: distance (radius + country/city example), preferences, lifestyle, response rate, account age, etc.
• Users can define who they are shown to (e.g., only shown to users without kids who want kids).
• Warning appears once more than 3 non-standard filters are active (age/gender excluded).
• Default sorting prioritizes users with the lowest views/matches; custom sorting overrides this.
• Negative swipes add to a hidden block list; resetting it is available periodically (every 6 months).

• Reporting supports escalating actions (warnings, reviews, bans). Severe reports trigger immediate review.
• False reporting penalties with recovery rules; good reporting increases daily positives.
• Personal data (phone/social) can only be shared via mutual request after matching.
• Chat detection warns when users try to share personal data outside approved flows.
• Users are informed that reported chats/photos can be reviewed by moderators.

• Single subscription tier (€0.99–€2.99/month) removes ads. No other premium features are core.
• Donate 30× the monthly price to request a lifetime subscription. This is goodwill only and can be revoked.
• Ads are not personalized and exclude gambling, erotic, or dating content.
• After 10 positive swipes in a day, watching an ad grants +3 positives; ads never show for subscribers.

• Premium-only feature: browse in a different location with a declared reason (travel/moving).\n• Profile shows travel mode in a distinct color and displays the actual home location.\n• Users can opt out of seeing travel mode profiles.
• Separate text-only profile and space; no media until both agree.\n• Blind mode matches are isolated from standard dating matches.

• Separate “meet people” space with its own filters and match logic.\n• Supports public events and groups (premium users can create up to 5 groups; everyone can join up to 20).\n• Groups can be filtered by criteria and have topics, dates, and public descriptions.

• Throttle swiping if like rate exceeds 80% or swipe rate exceeds X/min (average of last 5 active minutes).\n• Clear warning and 24-hour cooldown; account marked as potential spammer.\n• Mass-declining does not trigger spam rules.

• Admin portal: DAU/WAU/MAU, active subs, match rate, reports, storage, mod actions.\n• Mod portal: handle category suggestions, billing issues, report/ban reviews, and appeals.\n• Super mod portal: oversee mod actions, staffing recommendations, and escalations.

• Legal checklist to confirm: data retention rules, payment record retention, ID verification, and ban data storage limits.\n• Clarify whether a company is required or a private entity can host the service.\n• Lifetime subscription language must confirm it is goodwill and not guaranteed.
